items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the compatibility of the cycle class map with pushforward follows from the special case of a closed immersion whose conormal class in K theory is a pullback class (statement lines 5257-5264). The proof (proof lines 5265-5300) reduces to a closed immersion, introduces a Grassmannian bundle to make the conormal class a pullback, and verifies the hypothesis through the conormal sequence. H3: a multi step reduction, written out in full.
